runs:
description: >-
      Fail the check at this severity or worse: critical | high | medium | low
      | none. Fail-closed stopgap (0.4.1): the gate never reports PASS. It
      exits 1 FAIL (a finding at or above this threshold), 2 a config parsed
      to zero rules or an input was invalid, or 3 UNKNOWN (nothing reached the
      threshold, but the run is not certified: fail-closed stopgap pending
      soundness review). Exits 1, 2 and 3 all fail the check. `none` is
      advisory and always exits 0; its verdict still reads UNKNOWN or FAIL.
      policy attestations (FAILED, or INDETERMINATE under the 0.4.1
      fail-closed stopgap), and PCI/NIST/ISO/CIS/SOC 2/HIPAA
    description: >-
      Never true in 0.4.1 (fail-closed stopgap: no PASS is reported, under
      fail-on none too). Read `verdict` and `exit-code`.
  verdict:
    description: >-
      FAIL | UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN (exit 3) means nothing reached the fail-on
      threshold but the run is not certified: reason fail-closed-stopgap,
      "fail-closed stopgap pending soundness review". Under fail-on none this
      is the real verdict, reported but not enforced.
    value: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
  exit-code:
    description: >-
      The gate's exit code: 1 FAIL, 2 parse failure or invalid input, 3
      UNKNOWN; 0 only under fail-on none.
    value: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.exit_code }}
        rm -f "${SARIF}" "${JSON}" "${COMMENT}" "${EVIDENCE}" "${EVIDENCE_MD}"
        # before the exit code is even recorded. Bash 4.4 fixed it, so Linux
        # 'Enforce' step re-raises it after SARIF + comment have posted). It is
        # this step's own output, never a file in the shared RUNNER_TEMP: a
        # later use of the action in the same job whose gate step is skipped or
        # aborts must find no verdict, not this one.
        echo "exit_code=${RC}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
        print("verdict=" + str(d.get("verdict", "")))
    # Fails CLOSED when this use's gate step recorded no exit code: that step
    # was skipped or aborted before RuleHawk returned, and a missing verdict
    # must never read as "passed".
        RH_VERDICT: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
        # This use's own gate step output: empty when that step was skipped
        # or aborted before RuleHawk returned, whatever an earlier use left.
        RH_RC: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.exit_code }}
        RC="${RH_RC:-missing}"
          echo "::error title=RuleHawk gate did not complete::No verdict was recorded — the gate step was skipped or aborted before RuleHawk returned. See the step log above."
        elif [ "${RC}" = "3" ]; then
          echo "::error title=RuleHawk gate UNKNOWN (fail-closed-stopgap)::RuleHawk exited 3: no finding reached '${RH_FAIL_ON}', but this release reports no PASS — fail-closed stopgap pending soundness review (reason fail-closed-stopgap). Exit 3 fails the check until PASS returns where proven; for a non-blocking run, set fail-on: none."
          exit 1
        # Exit 0 only under fail-on none (advisory): never blocks, never reads
        # as a pass (fail-closed stopgap). An enforced exit 0 is unexpected in
        # 0.4.1 and fails closed.
        if [ "${RH_FAIL_ON}" != "none" ]; then
          echo "::error title=RuleHawk gate (fail-closed-stopgap)::RuleHawk exited 0 under fail-on '${RH_FAIL_ON}', which this release never does; failing closed (fail-closed stopgap pending soundness review)."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "::warning title=RuleHawk verdict ${RH_VERDICT:-UNKNOWN} (not enforced)::fail-on is none, so this step does not fail, but the verdict is ${RH_VERDICT:-UNKNOWN} (fail-closed stopgap pending soundness review). See the PR comment and job summary."
        echo "RuleHawk verdict: ${RH_VERDICT:-UNKNOWN} (not enforced: fail-on none; worst severity: ${RH_WORST})."
steps:
- name: Enforce gate verdict
      if: always()
      shell: bash
      env:
        # Bound as env, never ${{ }}-inlined into the script body (the same
        # script-injection hygiene as the comment step).
        RH_FAIL_ON: ${{ inputs.fail-on }}
        RH_WORST: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.worst }}
        RH_VERDICT: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
        # This use's own gate step output: empty when that step was skipped
        # or aborted before RuleHawk returned, whatever an earlier use left.
        RH_RC: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.exit_code }}
      run: |
        RC="${RH_RC:-missing}"
        if [ "${RC}" = "missing" ]; then
          echo "::error title=RuleHawk gate did not complete::No verdict was recorded — the gate step was skipped or aborted before RuleHawk returned. See the step log above."
          exit 1
        elif [ "${RC}" = "2" ]; then
          echo "::error title=RuleHawk gate failed (fail-closed)::RuleHawk exited 2: a config parsed to zero rules, a 'configs' pattern matched no files, or an input was invalid — it will not certify isolation it could not verify. See the step log; check the vendor/format or set the 'vendor' input."
          exit 1
        elif [ "${RC}" = "3" ]; then
          echo "::error title=RuleHawk gate UNKNOWN (fail-closed-stopgap)::RuleHawk exited 3: no finding reached '${RH_FAIL_ON}', but this release reports no PASS — fail-closed stopgap pending soundness review (reason fail-closed-stopgap). Exit 3 fails the check until PASS returns where proven; for a non-blocking run, set fail-on: none."
          exit 1
        elif [ "${RC}" != "0" ]; then
          echo "::error title=RuleHawk gate failed::Findings at or above '${RH_FAIL_ON}' block this change — see the job summary and PR comment."
          exit 1
        fi
        # Exit 0 only under fail-on none (advisory): never blocks, never reads
        # as a pass (fail-closed stopgap). An enforced exit 0 is unexpected in
        # 0.4.1 and fails closed.
        if [ "${RH_FAIL_ON}" != "none" ]; then
          echo "::error title=RuleHawk gate (fail-closed-stopgap)::RuleHawk exited 0 under fail-on '${RH_FAIL_ON}', which this release never does; failing closed (fail-closed stopgap pending soundness review)."
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "::warning title=RuleHawk verdict ${RH_VERDICT:-UNKNOWN} (not enforced)::fail-on is none, so this step does not fail, but the verdict is ${RH_VERDICT:-UNKNOWN} (fail-closed stopgap pending soundness review). See the PR comment and job summary."
        echo "RuleHawk verdict: ${RH_VERDICT:-UNKNOWN} (not enforced: fail-on none; worst severity: ${RH_WORST})."

runs:
# job did not succeed although its results show no failure. Fail-closed
# stopgap (0.4.1): never PASS; a check that does not fail is UNKNOWN, and a
# `passed: true` record from an older gate is UNKNOWN too.
    description: >-
      Fail this step on any enforced FAIL or UNKNOWN (true|false). In 0.4.1
      every enforced check that does not fail is UNKNOWN (fail-closed
      stopgap), so this step fails unless every check is fail-on none.
    description: >-
      FAIL | UNKNOWN: the worst verdict across every check, suffixed
      " (not enforced)" when only fail-on none checks have it. Never PASS in
      0.4.1 (fail-closed stopgap): a check that does not fail is UNKNOWN.
        VFILE="${BODY}.verdict"
          --comment "${BODY}" --verdict "${VFILE}"
        # ENFORCED is the verdict over the enforced checks: "PASS" here only
        # means no enforced check blocks (every check is fail-on none).
          0) ENFORCED=PASS ;;
          1) ENFORCED=FAIL ;;
          *) ENFORCED=UNKNOWN ;;
        VERDICT="${ENFORCED}"
        # Exit 0: only fail-on none checks; report the headline as shown.
        if [ "${RC}" = "0" ]; then
          VERDICT="$(head -n 1 "${VFILE}" 2>/dev/null)"
          # Fail-closed stopgap: 0.4.1 never reports PASS. A missing or empty
          # verdict file, or one that says PASS, is not trusted.
          case "${VERDICT}" in
            ""|PASS*) VERDICT=UNKNOWN; ENFORCED=UNKNOWN ;;
          esac
        fi
        # Belt and braces: a body that reads PASS is replaced, never posted
        # (the verdict is never PASS in 0.4.1).
        if [ -s "${BODY}" ] && grep -q '^## ✅' "${BODY}"; then
          ENFORCED=UNKNOWN
        { echo "verdict=${VERDICT}"; echo "enforced=${ENFORCED}"; echo "comment=${BODY}"; } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
        RH_ENFORCED: ${{ steps.combine.outputs.enforced }}
        if [ "${RH_ENFORCED:-UNKNOWN}" != "PASS" ]; then
          echo "::error title=RuleHawk combined verdict: ${RH_VERDICT:-UNKNOWN}::Not every RuleHawk check in this run passed — see the PR comment and each job's summary. An UNKNOWN check is the 0.4.1 fail-closed stopgap (fail-closed stopgap pending soundness review)."
        case "${RH_VERDICT:-}" in
          ""|PASS*)
            # 0.4.1 never reports PASS (fail-closed stopgap): fail closed.
            echo "::error title=RuleHawk combined verdict (fail-closed-stopgap)::Unexpected combined verdict '${RH_VERDICT:-}': this release never reports PASS (fail-closed stopgap pending soundness review); failing closed."
            exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "::warning title=RuleHawk combined verdict: ${RH_VERDICT}::Only fail-on none checks have this verdict; they are reported, not enforced."
steps:
- name: Combine every check
      id: combine
      shell: bash
      env:
        PYTHONPATH: ${{ github.action_path }}/..
        RH_EXPECT: ${{ inputs.expect }}
        RH_NEEDS: ${{ inputs.jobs }}
        RH_RESULTS: ${{ inputs.results }}
      run: |
        set -u
        IN="${RH_RESULTS:-${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/rulehawk-combine-in}"
        # A path of its own: a later invocation in the job must not overwrite
        # this one's comment-file output.
        BODY="$(mktemp "${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/rulehawk-combined-comment-XXXXXX")" \
          || BODY="${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/rulehawk-combined-comment-$$-${RANDOM}"
        rm -f "${BODY}"
        # noglob: the inputs are paths, split on whitespace only.
        set +e -f
        VFILE="${BODY}.verdict"
        python3 -m rulehawk combine ${IN} --expect "${RH_EXPECT}" --needs "${RH_NEEDS}" \
          --comment "${BODY}" --verdict "${VFILE}"
        RC=$?
        set +f
        # ENFORCED is the verdict over the enforced checks: "PASS" here only
        # means no enforced check blocks (every check is fail-on none).
        case "${RC}" in
          0) ENFORCED=PASS ;;
          1) ENFORCED=FAIL ;;
          *) ENFORCED=UNKNOWN ;;
        esac
        VERDICT="${ENFORCED}"
        # Exit 0: only fail-on none checks; report the headline as shown.
        if [ "${RC}" = "0" ]; then
          VERDICT="$(head -n 1 "${VFILE}" 2>/dev/null)"
          # Fail-closed stopgap: 0.4.1 never reports PASS. A missing or empty
          # verdict file, or one that says PASS, is not trusted.
          case "${VERDICT}" in
            ""|PASS*) VERDICT=UNKNOWN; ENFORCED=UNKNOWN ;;
          esac
        fi
        # Belt and braces: a body that reads PASS is replaced, never posted
        # (the verdict is never PASS in 0.4.1).
        if [ -s "${BODY}" ] && grep -q '^## ✅' "${BODY}"; then
          rm -f "${BODY}"
        fi
        if [ ! -s "${BODY}" ]; then
          VERDICT=UNKNOWN
          ENFORCED=UNKNOWN
          printf '%s\n## ❌ RuleHawk firewall gate: UNKNOWN\n\nThe checks could not be combined into a comment; see the job log.\n' \
            '<!-- rulehawk-gate -->' > "${BODY}"
        fi
        { echo "verdict=${VERDICT}"; echo "enforced=${ENFORCED}"; echo "comment=${BODY}"; } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
    - name: Enforce the combined verdict
      if: always() && inputs.fail == 'true'
      shell: bash
      env:
        RH_VERDICT: ${{ steps.combine.outputs.verdict }}
        RH_ENFORCED: ${{ steps.combine.outputs.enforced }}
      run: |
        if [ "${RH_ENFORCED:-UNKNOWN}" != "PASS" ]; then
          echo "::error title=RuleHawk combined verdict: ${RH_VERDICT:-UNKNOWN}::Not every RuleHawk check in this run passed — see the PR comment and each job's summary. An UNKNOWN check is the 0.4.1 fail-closed stopgap (fail-closed stopgap pending soundness review)."
          exit 1
        fi
        case "${RH_VERDICT:-}" in
          ""|PASS*)
            # 0.4.1 never reports PASS (fail-closed stopgap): fail closed.
            echo "::error title=RuleHawk combined verdict (fail-closed-stopgap)::Unexpected combined verdict '${RH_VERDICT:-}': this release never reports PASS (fail-closed stopgap pending soundness review); failing closed."
            exit 1 ;;
        esac
        echo "::warning title=RuleHawk combined verdict: ${RH_VERDICT}::Only fail-on none checks have this verdict; they are reported, not enforced."
